counting_rule: DANS four disciplinary repositories count as one institution; distinct national and regional government publishers count separately. Existing sources are excluded.
acquisition_policy: Only content-verified entity-data files are displayed; downloads use the shared streaming and resume pipeline with no fixed file-size cap. Original format and available version, license and checksum evidence are retained.
selection_behavior: With no source selected, the planner matches relevant enabled sources. Manual choices constrain retrieval to those sources. Planner fallback may query all allowed enabled sources.
verification_scope: Each enabled source has a completely downloaded sample. This proves its integration path, not permanent availability of every record or permission to reuse every file; source licenses remain authoritative. Sample hashes identify the exact bytes downloaded during validation; dynamically generated exports can differ across acquisition times, and each acquisition stores its own SHA256.
